gallery.filename: Electric Microbus Transport at Taman Mini Indonesia Indah.jpg
gallery.title: File:Electric Microbus Transport at Taman Mini Indonesia Indah.jpg
gallery.description: Taman Mini Indonesia Indah is a miniature park complex of the diversity of Indonesian culture located in East Jakarta, Jakarta, Indonesia. It was opened in 1975 and revitalized in 2022. Since its reopening in early 2023, visitors are no longer allowed to explore the complex using personal motorcycles or cars (except for registered tour buses), because the complex has become a low-emission zone. Visitors can use electric microbuses to explore the complex or rent bicycles or electric scooters.

gallery.description: Keong Mas Plaza is one of the new public plazas in Taman Mini Indonesia Indah, Jakarta, Indonesia, which is the terrace of the Keong Mas IMAX Theatre, the landmark of TMII. The plaza is built as an entrance plaza for visitors from the pedestrian entrance on TMII gate 3. The site of Keong Mas Plaza was previously used as a parking lot.
